title: chat-types: AddRole placeholder role id
description: Follow-up from JMAP-dpbp. SpacePatchOp::AddRole(SpaceRole) carries a placeholder role id (space.rs fills "" for addRoles entries, which draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §Space/set addRoles says carry no id: 'Server assigns ULIDs'); the backend replaces it before storing (crate-jmap-chat-types/src/space_set.rs SpacePatchOp docs). Not the create_object path JMAP-dpbp changed, and the replacement is unconditional (no value comparison), so no collision bug. Fix: an id-less RoleCreate payload for AddRole (SpacePatchOp derives Clone/PartialEq, so a builder closure does not fit). Tests in chat-server tests/role_member_apply.rs, channel_category_apply.rs and integration.rs send "id": "placeholder" in addRoles entries and would drop it.
close_reason: Batch 19 (run wf_1f7c9883-837): implemented, adversarially verified, full CI green at b9d3d860
